templates.subtopic: Nets
templates.source: Y9 Autumn B3 Area and volume · S1 Nets
templates.text: A net has [[n]] triangles and 1 polygon with [[n]] sides. Which solid does it make? How many faces, edges and vertices does it have?
templates.answer: a pyramid whose base has [[n]] sides: [[n + 1]] faces, [[2 * n]] edges, [[n + 1]] vertices

templates.subtopic: Nets
